title: [Chapitre] IV. Analysis situs (première mouture) : notes manuscrites (10/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inferred from pp. 22-24. There is a poset (M, ≤) of 'multi-strates' (multistrata) and a set L. Each X in M gives a subset L_X ⊂ L, a 'closed' set, and its 'open stratum' L_X° = L_X minus the union of the L_{X'} for X' < X. A symmetric 'compatibility' relation R holds on M. A 'figure' F ⊂ M is a set of pairwise compatible multistrata, and it is implicitly closed under passing to smaller elements. From earlier results (the image reads 'Conj 3, Conj 4') one has L_X = ⋃_{Y≤X} L_Y°. Conj 4 says that distinct compatible X, Y have disjoint open strata. Equivalently, L_X ∩ L_Y = ⋃_{Z≤X, Z≤Y} L_Z.

The Scholie, for a figure F:
(a) The open strata L_X° (X ∈ F) are non-empty and pairwise disjoint. They partition L_F = ⋃_{X∈F} L_X = ⋃_{X∈F} L_X°. Hence X ↦ L_X° is injective on F.
(b) X ↦ L_X is injective on F. More precisely, for X, Y in F the following are equivalent: (i) X ≤ Y; (ii) L_X ⊂ L_Y; (iii) L_X° ⊂ L_Y; (iv) L_X° ∩ L_Y ≠ ∅. So F embeds as an ordered set into (P(L), ⊂) through closures of strata.
(c) L_X ∩ L_Y = ⋃_{Z∈F, Z≤X, Z≤Y} L_Z.

Proof of (b). The steps (i)⇒(ii)⇒(iii)⇒(iv) are trivial; (iii)⇒(iv) uses non-emptiness. For (iv)⇒(i): write L_Y = ⋃_{Y_i≤Y} L_{Y_i}°. Then L_X° meets some L_{Y_i}°, so by (a) X = Y_i ≤ Y.

Proof of (c), not written but immediate. A point x of L_X ∩ L_Y lies in a unique L_Z° with Z in F. By (iv)⇒(i), Z ≤ X and Z ≤ Y.

In modern terms these are the standard combinatorial axioms of a stratification indexed by a poset: strata partition the space, the closure of a stratum is a union of strata (frontier condition), and the order on strata is recovered by closure inclusion. The page serves Grothendieck's 1986 'Analysis situs' programme, apparently a combinatorial or 'tame' axiomatics of stratified objects (multistrata, figures). The next page aims to recover (M, ≤, compatibility) entirely from L and the families L̂_X of 'open structures', by an injection M → P(P(L)).
errors: Statement (a) and hence (b) depend on Conj 3/Conj 4, which on p. 22 are conjectures, not proven results. The Scholie is conditional.
The proof of (iv)⇒(i) applies (a) to X and Y_i. This requires Y_i ∈ F, so F must be down-closed (figure = ideal of pairwise compatible elements); this is implicit.
Non-emptiness of L_X° is needed for (iii)⇒(iv) and for injectivity in (a). It is not justified on this page, presumably coming from an earlier corollary.

The added marginal remark claims the equivalences (i)-(iv) hold without assuming X, Y compatible. This looks unjustified. The proof uses disjointness of open strata (Conj 4) for the pair X, Y_i, which requires compatibility. The next page in fact needs the finer invariants L̂_X to separate incompatible multistrata, and the diagonal margin seems to warn that injectivity fails on all of M.

ideas.what: Open strata of a figure are non-empty, disjoint and partition the union of the closed strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: Whitney, Thom, Mather (stratified spaces); in poset form e.g. Lurie, Higher Algebra App. A
ideas.where_published: Tame topology is evoked in Esquisse d'un programme (1984) but not with this axiomatics

ideas.what: Order on strata recovered by inclusion of closures, with the equivalent conditions (i)-(iv)
ideas.modern_name: Frontier condition; strata poset embeds into closed sets

ideas.what: Intersection of closed strata equals the union of closed strata below both
ideas.modern_name: Closure-of-strata lattice property (as for faces of a regular CW / simplicial complex)

missed.claim: The whole Scholie rests on Conj 3 / Conj 4 (disjointness of open strata of compatible multistrata) within Grothendieck's unpublished 'multi-strate/figure' axiomatics of analysis situs. Whether these conjectures were proven or the axiomatics completed is not visible here. Interest lies more in the framework (multistrata, compatibility, figures, recovering M from P(P(L))) than in this routine lemma.
missed.quote: En utilisant Conj 3, Conj 4, on trouve la Scholie
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only as documentation of Grothendieck's attempted combinatorial foundation for tame topology. The page's own content is standard stratification combinatorics.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine poset/stratification bookkeeping (partition by open strata, frontier condition, order via closures), conditional on earlier conjectures. It is only of archival interest as part of the unpublished 1986 analysis situs framework.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 likely reads 'En utilisant Conj 3, Conj 4' (conjectures, cf. 'Conj 4' on p. 22), not 'Cor 3, Cor 4'.
Margin by (b) reads approximately: 'i.e. si X, Y sont compatibles et L_X = L_Y alors X = Y'.
Boxed margin at (c) reads 'Idem pour c)'.

The diagonal left margin seems to begin 'Mais bien sûr on n'a pas ... injectivité ... multi-strates ...' (tentative). It is probably a warning that X ↦ L_X (or L_X°) is not injective on all of M, only on figures.
